dct_description_sm: County Trails - The CP Rail Trail is a multi-use trail permitting many recreational activities including cycling, hiking, walking, ATV use in designated areas, cross country skiing, equestrian, snowshoeing and snowmobiling. The trails within Grey County Forests are enjoyed by both visitors and local residents. Various forest properties are used for recreational activities such as, hunting, mountain biking, hiking, walking, birding, cross country skiing and snowmobiling.
